assertions: Only approved template artifacts generate the initial case document version; every generated or returned document has a SHA-256 and immutable lineage.
A client document cannot be generated or sent until every staff segment has a returned signature and an exact commitment exists.
An exact deposit may make the order established before client signing, while contract state remains waiting-for-client-signature and no execution schedule exists.

Execution conversion requires exact commitment coverage, customer contract completion and settled deposit; all failed guards have zero formal row delta.
